stance_rationale: BHEQ has salvageable evidence, but the package is not internally consistent: the declared BHEQ alpha vector does not match the referenced alpha_scores artifact, hard liquidity mandate is not met, and selected-signal diagnostics were not regenerated. This cannot proceed to approval without a clean rerun and lineage repair.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is multi-date, so RF-A7 single-snapshot is not triggered. However the package-selected BHEQ alpha_vector has 281 names while the referenced parquet score_main remains P3-based and has only 67 finite score_main values on 2026-04-30.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: BHEQ uses Z_Score_Aligned, but package factor_specs and alpha_scores still include BOCPD/P3 logic with -sign(cum_3m_ret) and P3 score_main; selected artifact was not regenerated after BHEQ-only reframe.
Factor loading path calls load_month_factors(sig_d), and connector filters IC history by Usable_Date <= sig_date.

Main factor values use load_month_factors, but alpha_generate_bayesian.R also directly reads .cache/factor_db/factor_ic_monthly.parquet; the draft therefore does not satisfy exclusive connector-only discipline.
BOCPD return window uses Date <= sig_d - 1; no same-day regime overlay was observed.
The BHEQ components are loaded through the factor DB path and package lag_rule states quarterly 45d DART lag.

critical_concerns.description: Declared BHEQ alpha_vector and signal_matrix_ref are inconsistent: package alpha_vector has 281 BHEQ names, while alpha_scores.parquet score_main is still P3-based and only 67 finite on 2026-04-30; the package reference path also points to stage_artifacts/WT_D20260501_003, which is absent from repo root.
The alpha was generated with liquidity floor 5e7 despite the base hard constraint of 20d TV >= 2e8; no 2e8 rerun or Q-Lead override artifact exists.
BHEQ rank_IC is 0.0313, below the KR alpha gate 0.04, and the selected BHEQ DSR/monotonicity were not officially regenerated in the package despite the reframe from P3.

The final claim relies on a single-sleeve earnings-quality alpha; AX-004 exclusion requires more than a quality-family rebrand, and AX-007 is not satisfied by merely having 281 scores before downstream top-20 selection.
RF-A3 is triggered: BHEQ recent 36-month ICIR is 0.655 versus full ICIR 0.355, ratio 1.85 > 1.5, so the strongest evidence may be regime-local rather than stable.
BOCPD/P3 are described in factor_specs after being dropped, and BOCPD uses an explicit reversal sign transform; this keeps a PIT-C13 gray-zone signal in the package surface.
Charter 8 No Silent Override is not met: challenge_note.md, final alpha_package.json, codex response, artifact_lineage, requested weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent for this worktask.
Academic mechanism support is underspecified: references lack page-level citations, KR applicability relies mainly on L-121/Q07, and RF-A4 sector-neutral degradation is not reported.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 single-snapshot is not the main failure: alpha_scores.parquet has 220 Date x Ticker observations from 2008-01-31 to 2026-04-30.
Independent artifact check reproduces BHEQ ICIR about 0.3547 and NW-t about 5.0713.
Independent BHEQ monotonicity recompute gives decile Spearman about 0.8667 and BHEQ DSR about 0.972, but these are not the official package diagnostics and must be regenerated into the package.
unresolved_disputes: Whether 5e7 liquidity can override the base 2e8 hard mandate without an explicit Q-Lead artifact.
Whether BHEQ-only is the selected alpha or P3 remains selected in the referenced time-series artifact.
Whether AX-004 and AX-007 exclusions are actually satisfied after downstream optimizer reduces to max 20 names.
Whether missing weights.csv and covariance.parquet are out-of-scope for alpha or evidence of incomplete worktask packaging.
weakest_assumption: The package assumes that an after-the-fact BHEQ-only reframe is valid even though the referenced alpha_scores artifact, diagnostics, lineage, and hard-liquidity universe were not regenerated for that selected signal.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate alpha_scores.parquet with score_main equal to BHEQ-only, and make alpha_vector exactly reproducible from the artifact on 2026-04-30.
Rerun or formally override the 2e8 20d TV hard liquidity floor; report top-decile liquidity under the final selected signal.
Recompute official BHEQ rank_IC, ICIR, NW-t, DSR, monotonicity, subperiods, RF-A3, and sector-neutral RF-A4 diagnostics.
Produce challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json with write_json to record_lineage ordering.
Demonstrate AX-004 and AX-007 compliance after optimizer handoff, not just in pre-optimizer score breadth.
rationalization_red_flags: Bayesian posterior_t = f(posterior_{t-1}, observation_t) is by definition PIT-clean
single-factor BHEQ monotonicity TBD next cycle
request followed but Q-Lead override required

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The strongest issue is not Bayesian methodology but package integrity: selected signal, artifact path, diagnostics, and governance evidence disagree.

alpha_specific_questions: Can BHEQ maintain rank_IC >= 0.04 after applying the 2e8 liquidity floor and sector-neutral RF-A4 test?
Can alpha_vector be rebuilt exactly from alpha_scores.parquet without relying on a separate draft-building transformation?
